title: After 10 months of iteration I've finally launched my AI assisted game | Void Descent
author: TrashcanThrowaway999
selftext:
After 10 months of work, the 1.0 release is officially live!

The biggest update is a full 3D graphics overhaul. Every player ship, enemy, weapon and visual effect has been redesigned for high fidelity 3D. I've kept the original 2D look for mobile or anyone who prefers the retro style.

A completely new scoring mechanic has been introduced as well in the form of real time combat rank. As you play you'll be graded on your positioning and aggression while avoiding damage, the cleaner and more precise you fight, the higher your score is multiplied. But be careful, if you take damage or start playing it too safe your rank will suffer.

I've also tackled the largest issue with the PC experience: widescreen support is now fully integrated! Along with that comes complete native controller compatibility (also tested and working on ROG Ally - I don't have access to a steam deck though so please let me know how it works!)

My goal was to offer a game that you can play on any device with any hardware and 0 installs, and this current experience is one I'm really proud of.

AI was used to assist in writing the code, generating the music and UI audio, and the 3D assets. The gameplay mechanics, architecture, balancing, and overall vision was mine 

Let me know what you think!

Play here - [Void Descent](https://real-brainded.itch.io/void-descent)

comments.author: jildos_legoplanet
comments.body: I tried 2D version and I like it! It is nice and chaotic without being overly difficult. The level up popup is a turnoff for me, it interupts the gameplay massively and it is not needed this way since you build in the slowdown when not active (nice touch btw)

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Thank you for checking it out! Totally fair on the upgrade popup interrupting gameplay, if you aren't a fan of the survivorlike/bullet heaven genre (this is a core mechanic) I can definitely see it being off-putting.

Thank you for the feedback!

comments.author: jildos_legoplanet
comments.body: Also just tried 3D but that crashed for me once reaching Lvl3

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Are you on iOS by any chance? There are some brick walls with iOS and web based games that I just can't overcome unfortunately.

If not I will definitely look into it if you don't mind sharing what device/OS you're using.

replies.author: jildos_legoplanet
replies.body: Yes on IOS 26.6 on an Iphone16

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body: Yea, iOS has a very aggressive watchdog in the webkit that terminates browser tabs using over I think 300MB of memory, so 3d mode chews through that no matter how much I optimize. Lesson learned, next game will be on a proper engine. Thanks again for the info 🤘🏻🤘🏻

comments.author: Hoboken_Pickle
comments.body: The slowdown is really good... the plasma beam weapon seems to glitch depending on what weapons its paired with maybe? The bosses are fun and definitely have an interesting tool kit to keep things interesting. I might recommend some incentive for players to explore a bit more of space in general since there wasn't much of a reason for me not to just do a broad circle and draw enemies away to come back and collect my gems/HP crates.

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Thanks for checking out the game! Plasma beam is actually a weapon I'm in the process of reworking as we speak including it's targeting logic. 

I agree it would be awesome to have some more interesting things happening out in the space around you. I'm currently thinking about little objectives or something that incentivized that. Glad to hear it's something that would be welcomed by players.

Keep an eye out for the next update coming this weekend, I'm reworking some core systems that haven't felt 100% right so things should continue to feel better.

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body: Ty!

replies.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
replies.body: btw, i'd like to be able to control it using the keyboard.

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body: In the settings there's WASD option!

comments.author: Specific_Ordinary499
comments.body:
I really like it, one of the best vibe coded games ive played, and just a fun game in general. It's like Crimsonland/Vampire Survivors in space!  
Maybe the end final boss comes a bit too soon, it would be neat to have more waves in between

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Thank you, that means a lot!  You're actually the first person to tell me that the main 50 level run feels short. Either you are really enjoying yourself or your bill was absolutely killer 🤘🏻🤘🏻

Once you beat the final boss, you unlock five levels of Ascension and then an endless mode so at that point you can play as long as you stay alive!

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body: Thank you, I really appreciate it!

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body: Not sure I understand the question, do you mean sound effects? Right now it's just music soundtrack and UI sounds. Considering adding more in the future.

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: played it.  no sound effects, which is a bummer, but I know sound design is hard.  I think if you have enemies with different movement behaviors that would be cool.  The final boss was cool.  I wish we have a dodge roll.  Or the ship version, like a hyperspace dash or something.  on a cooldown.  Some kind of active defensive ability.  Ricochet seems much stronger than other weapons.  If we trade out a weapon, do we get to keep the levels and elements.  if not, there is little reason to ever switch.  There also seems to be little reason to invest in magnet if those vaccuum all pickups magnet thing drops regularly, which it seems to.  To be fair, I did put a lot of upgrades into luck.

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Yea sound is tricky since there so much going on and so many enemies, I want to be careful not to make it overwhelming chaotic noise but I'm definitely thinking more about it.

Dodge roll/dash is something I would love to add but it was originally designed for mobile touch and controls for that were a little more challenging but I'm still not ruling it out so I appreciate the feedback!

Also if you stacked luck yes the magnets will drop pretty frequently, the luck system is something I'm about to revise on my next update this weekend along with some weapon balancing so keep an eye out!

Thanks again for taking the time to play and comment 🙌🏻

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body:
Hmmm, for mobile, dash maybe a double tap?  And for ultimate use 3 fingers? 

When you turn an enemy to your side, does it actually do anything?  Like the basic enemy, do they actually damage anything?

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Yea I'm thinking maybe dash could be a second tap while your already steering (so using your other thumb) - the tricky part about double tap is which direction would you dash if you didn't drag your finger?

When basic enemies are hacked they will chase after other enemies and do melee damage to them (you will see the cyan damage number with elemental icon)

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: As it is, just dash in the direction they are moving when double tapped.  You could do a 2 finder tap for rare, activated abilities.  maybe pickups.

comments.author: promptling
comments.body: would love to have you post it on [patchloop.io](http://patchloop.io) so people can test it and get rewarded for providing quality feedback.

comments.author: redPistolStar
comments.body: Looks like you went with the webview option for mobile version. Why not go with cordova and build apps for Android/ios?

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body: It was just originally a fun side project for myself and it just kept getting bigger and bigger so I decided to release it. I also liked that it didn't require an install or anything, you could play from anywhere at any time. If/when I make another game I will most likely go with a proper engine but has been a massive learning experience and a ton of fun anyway.

comments.author: Tyalou
comments.body: Great game, I played more than I should have on a busy morning. Very promising, now you need to find a way to switch it up. Got to the point where I had to kill 2 titans and the game was starting to feel a bit too samey.

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Thank you so much for checking it out! 

Totally hear you on the repetitive nature of multiple titans. I have some ideas on how to maybe do different types of titans with different attacks / themes.

Also once you beat the final boss at level 50 you start unlocking more game modes and the augment lab which has meta progression with permanent passive buffs to equip.

Thanks again for the feedback it's always super helpful to know how the players feel at various stages of the game, keep an eye out for an update this weekend and steam release coming soon! 🤘🏻

comments.author: MysteriousRatio231
comments.body:
gj! i like the bullet-time geometry wars idea, lots of  cool detailed ideas for powers and weapons and the progression system, playing more than I should for sure, kuddos.   
  
You could try smoothing out the transition between paused and unpaused moments to give players some time to get their bearings after a sudden stop and consider doing something so that the action doesn't continue around the player when they use supers... I'm invincible but also confused. =)    
  
Are you tracking how many times that 1 song plays on average per run? Because man it can be tedious. If you are generating music with AI, splurge, get a couple tracks in there to mix it up at least. 3D didn't perform well for me so 2D for me.

replies.author: TrashcanThrowaway999
replies.body:
Thank you for playing and for the great feedback!

I have already reworked how ultimates work and will be included in an update later today. I agree it was not very intuitive with the camera pan.

I can absolutely add more music variety in the future.

Can I ask what device and OS you were playing on that 3d was not performing well? Was it crashing or just low framerate?
